Name: Pelican Postal Service
Author: ElectroCrumpet
Description:
This mod lets you send gifts and quest items to NPCs from anywhere in the world! Open the menu with Y (configurable) while holding a gift, select an NPC, and voila! The mod updates your gift statistics and friendship points like usual.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*] Download this mod and unzip into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using [code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code].
[/list]
[size=4]Notes[/size]
[list]
[*] You can only send items to NPCs you've met before. Marriage-related items (Mermaid's Pendant, Bouquet, Wedding Ring) are not allowed.
[*] To change the hotkey, start the game once and check the mod folder for [code]config.json[/code]. Use [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]this page[/url] for help with hotkey options.
[*] If your account is newly created, you have to open your inventory at least once before the mod will work. This is a quirk with the base game.
[*]The mod works with most quests, but some require that you arrive in person. The quest description will tell you.
[/list]
[size=3]Config options[/size]
[list]
[*] [code][ MenuAccessKey ][/code]
[*] [code][ AllowQuestSubmissions ]﻿[/code] Whether or not to allow quest submissions (default: [code]true[/code])
[*] [code][ LazyItemChecking﻿ ][/code] When turned on, gathering quests will be marked as finished based on the number of items you have remaining. For example, you can collect 10/20 Copper Ore and send the rest to Clint. When turned off, you need the entire batch in your inventory. (default: [code]false[/code])
[/list]
